answer: An attacker buying 50 seats in the basalt pool lifts the clearing price from 2 to 9 tokens, a 350-token cost that a single seat’s 4-token reward cannot cover. Whisper nodes verify seat ownership at epoch close and reject duplicate proofs, forcing the attacker to pay the full 450-token price for zero additional yield. Glacier auditors flag any account holding more than 30 seats, capping total revenue at 120 tokens against a 450-token outlay, ensuring the mass cloning strategy ends strictly in the red.
